questions.content: <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.885ex" height="1.62ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -716 833 716" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="394" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-394"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>U is equal to :
questions.explanation:
From 1st law of thermodynamics

ΔU = q + w

For adiabatic process :

q = 0

ΔU = w

So change in internal energy (ΔU) is equal to adiabatic work.
